-------------------------- MODULE W4Od1m1p0t4 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Controllers, N

ASSUME NAssume == N \in Nat /\ N >= 1 /\ Controllers = 0 .. (N - 1)

VARIABLES token, transit, member, mode
vars == << token, transit, member, mode >>

Members == { c \in Controllers : member[c] = TRUE }

Succ(t) == (t + 1) % N

\* The next ring member strictly after t in cyclic order (or t if none other).
NextMember(t) ==
  IF \E k \in 1 .. N : ((t + k) % N) \in Members
  THEN CHOOSE m \in Members :
         \E k \in 1 .. N :
           m = ((t + k) % N)
           /\ \A j \in 1 .. (k - 1) : ((t + j) % N) \notin Members
  ELSE t

TypeOK ==
  /\ token \in Controllers
  /\ transit \in BOOLEAN
  /\ member \in [Controllers -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ mode \in [Controllers -> {"idle", "waiting", "using"}]

Init ==
  /\ token = 0
  /\ transit = FALSE
  /\ member = [c \in Controllers |-> TRUE]
  /\ mode = [c \in Controllers |-> "idle"]

Request(c) ==
  /\ member[c] = TRUE
  /\ mode[c] = "idle"
  /\ mode' = [mode EXCEPT ![c] = "waiting"]
  /\ UNCHANGED << token, transit, member >>

Enter(c) ==
  /\ member[c] = TRUE
  /\ mode[c] = "waiting"
  /\ c = token
  /\ transit = FALSE
  /\ mode' = [mode EXCEPT ![c] = "using"]
  /\ UNCHANGED << token, transit, member >>

Exit(c) ==
  /\ mode[c] = "using"
  /\ mode' = [mode EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
  /\ transit' = TRUE
  /\ UNCHANGED << token, member >>

BeginPass ==
  /\ transit = FALSE
  /\ mode[token] # "using"
  /\ transit' = TRUE
  /\ UNCHANGED << token, member, mode >>

Deliver ==
  /\ transit = TRUE
  /\ token' = NextMember(token)
  /\ transit' = FALSE
  /\ UNCHANGED << member, mode >>

Leave(c) ==
  /\ member[c] = TRUE
  /\ mode[c] = "idle"
  /\ c # token
  /\ Cardinality(Members) >= 2
  /\ member' = [member EXCEPT ![c] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED << token, transit, mode >>

Join(c) ==
  /\ member[c] = FALSE
  /\ member' = [member EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
  /\ mode' = [mode EXCEPT ![c] = "idle"]
  /\ UNCHANGED << token, transit >>

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Controllers : Request(c)
  \/ \E c \in Controllers : Enter(c)
  \/ \E c \in Controllers : Exit(c)
  \/ BeginPass
  \/ Deliver
  \/ \E c \in Controllers : Leave(c)
  \/ \E c \in Controllers : Join(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Mutual exclusion, expressed as a subset-of-singleton fact rather than a
\* counting bound: whoever is on the crossing must be the resting token holder.
ExclusiveCrossing ==
  /\ { c \in Controllers : mode[c] = "using" } \subseteq {token}
  /\ \A c \in Controllers : mode[c] = "using" => transit = FALSE
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  N = 3
  Controllers = {0, 1, 2}
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT ExclusiveCrossing
nl:
An air-traffic runway allocator coordinates a set of tower controllers who share one active runway crossing. The controllers are arranged in a logical ring and pass a single circulating token around it; only the controller currently holding the token, and only while the token is resting (not in transit between hops), may bring an aircraft onto the runway. A controller first requests access, then enters the crossing when it holds the resting token, and finally exits, which starts the token moving toward the next ring member. Because the ring's membership changes at runtime, controllers may join the ring or leave it while idle, so the number of participants sharing the token grows and shrinks during operation. When the token is delivered it always advances to the next controller that is still a member, wrapping cyclically. A controller that has left the ring cannot enter the crossing, and the token is never handed to a non-member. The whole point of the single token is that the runway crossing is never occupied by two aircraft at once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: At every reachable state the only controller that can be occupying the runway crossing is the current resting token holder, so two controllers are never on the crossing simultaneously.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od13m3p6t3 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Machines, MaxEpoch, MaxActs

VARIABLES epoch, role, term, suspected, actLog
vars == << epoch, role, term, suspected, actLog >>

NoCoordinator == \A m \in Machines : role[m] # "coordinator"

TypeOK ==
  /\ epoch \in 0 .. MaxEpoch
  /\ role \in [Machines -> {"follower", "candidate", "coordinator"}]
  /\ term \in [Machines -> 0 .. MaxEpoch]
  /\ suspected \in [Machines -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ actLog \in 0 .. MaxActs

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ role = [m \in Machines |-> "follower"]
  /\ term = [m \in Machines |-> 0]
  /\ suspected = [m \in Machines |-> FALSE]
  /\ actLog = 0

StartElection(c) ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ role[c] # "coordinator"
  /\ ((\E m \in Machines : suspected[m]) \/ NoCoordinator)
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ term' = [term EXCEPT ![c] = epoch + 1]
  /\ role' = [m \in Machines |-> IF m = c THEN "candidate" ELSE "follower"]
  /\ suspected' = [m \in Machines |-> FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED actLog

WinElection(c) ==
  /\ role[c] = "candidate"
  /\ term[c] = epoch
  /\ NoCoordinator
  /\ role' = [role EXCEPT ![c] = "coordinator"]
  /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, term, suspected, actLog >>

Suspect(m) ==
  /\ role[m] = "coordinator"
  /\ suspected[m] = FALSE
  /\ suspected' = [suspected EXCEPT ![m] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, role, term, actLog >>

Recover(m) ==
  /\ role[m] = "coordinator"
  /\ suspected[m] = TRUE
  /\ suspected' = [suspected EXCEPT ![m] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, role, term, actLog >>

CommitCommand(m) ==
  /\ role[m] = "coordinator"
  /\ term[m] = epoch
  /\ suspected[m] = FALSE
  /\ actLog < MaxActs
  /\ actLog' = actLog + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, role, term, suspected >>

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Machines : StartElection(c)
  \/ \E c \in Machines : WinElection(c)
  \/ \E m \in Machines : Suspect(m)
  \/ \E m \in Machines : Recover(m)
  \/ \E m \in Machines : CommitCommand(m)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Authority currency: whoever holds the coordinator role carries the live epoch
\* as its term; a machine whose term has fallen behind can hold no authority.
AuthorityIsCurrent ==
  \A m \in Machines : role[m] = "coordinator" => term[m] = epoch
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Machines = {m1, m2, m3}
  MaxEpoch = 3
  MaxActs = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT AuthorityIsCurrent
nl:
A network of smart vending machines elects one coordinator that is allowed to push restock and price-change commands to the fleet. Coordination uses monotonically increasing election epochs: each new election bumps a global epoch and the winning machine records that epoch as its term. The reigning coordinator can become slow to respond, in which case peers merely suspect it rather than declaring it dead, because a slow machine may still recover on its own. When a coordinator is suspected, or when the fleet has no coordinator at all, any non-coordinator may start a fresh election, which advances the epoch, makes the caller a candidate, and simultaneously demotes the previous coordinator to a plain follower. A candidate whose term matches the current epoch wins and becomes coordinator only while no other coordinator exists. Only a coordinator whose term equals the current epoch and that is not currently suspected may commit a fleet command. A machine that recovers from suspicion regains normal standing without a new election. The design guarantees that stale machines can never quietly keep issuing commands after the epoch has moved on.
SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state, any machine holding the coordinator role has a term equal to the current global epoch, so no stale coordinator retains authority.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od5m4p5t1 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Players, Games, QCap, GSlots, MaxRefused

VARIABLES waiting, issued, slots, refused
vars == << waiting, issued, slots, refused >>

Tokens == [player : Players, game : Games]

AlreadyIssued(p) == \E r \in issued : r.player = p

TypeOK ==
  /\ waiting \subseteq Players
  /\ issued \subseteq Tokens
  /\ slots \in [Games -> 0 .. GSlots]
  /\ refused \in 0 .. MaxRefused

Init ==
  /\ waiting = {}
  /\ issued = {}
  /\ slots = [g \in Games |-> GSlots]
  /\ refused = 0

Enqueue(p) ==
  /\ p \notin waiting
  /\ ~AlreadyIssued(p)
  /\ Cardinality(waiting) < QCap
  /\ waiting' = waiting \cup {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED << issued, slots, refused >>

RefuseRequest(p) ==
  /\ p \notin waiting
  /\ ~AlreadyIssued(p)
  /\ Cardinality(waiting) = QCap
  /\ refused < MaxRefused
  /\ refused' = refused + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED << waiting, issued, slots >>

Cancel(p) ==
  /\ p \in waiting
  /\ waiting' = waiting \ {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED << issued, slots, refused >>

Match(p, g) ==
  /\ p \in waiting
  /\ ~AlreadyIssued(p)
  /\ slots[g] > 0
  /\ issued' = issued \cup {[player |-> p, game |-> g]}
  /\ waiting' = waiting \ {p}
  /\ slots' = [slots EXCEPT ![g] = slots[g] - 1]
  /\ UNCHANGED refused

AllSettled ==
  /\ waiting = {}
  /\ \A p \in Players : AlreadyIssued(p) \/ (\A g \in Games : slots[g] = 0)

Next ==
  \/ \E p \in Players : Enqueue(p)
  \/ \E p \in Players : RefuseRequest(p)
  \/ \E p \in Players : Cancel(p)
  \/ \E p \in Players, g \in Games : Match(p, g)
  \/ (AllSettled /\ UNCHANGED vars)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Irreversible-at-most-once as a functional-dependency fact on the token set:
\* player is a key, so no player can be bound to two distinct match tokens.
SeatedAtMostOnce ==
  \A r1, r2 \in issued : r1.player = r2.player => r1 = r2
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Players = {p1, p2, p3}
  Games = {g1, g2}
  QCap = 2
  GSlots = 2
  MaxRefused = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT SeatedAtMostOnce
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby runs a matchmaker that collects join requests from players and seats them into game instances. Pending requests sit in a bounded holding pool; the matchmaker does not preserve arrival order, so it may pull any waiting player next and requests are effectively reordered. When the pool is already at its capacity, a further request is refused rather than buffered, which is the backpressure that protects the matchmaker from overload, and refused requests are counted. Each game instance has a fixed number of open seats, and seating a player consumes one seat of the chosen instance. Placing a player into a game is irreversible: it mints a durable match token binding that player to that instance. A waiting player may cancel and drop out of the pool before being matched. The matchmaker refuses to seat a player who already holds a match token, so no one is ever double-booked into two instances. The invariant of interest is that the set of minted tokens never contains two different tokens for the same player.
SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state, any two match tokens that name the same player are identical, so each player is irreversibly seated at most once.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od10m0p4t3 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Trains, NumBlocks, MaxMoves

Blocks == 1 .. NumBlocks
\* Short interlocking blocks hold one train; the last (platform) block holds two.
Cap(b) == IF b = NumBlocks THEN 2 ELSE 1

VARIABLES pos, version, attempt, delayed, moves
vars == << pos, version, attempt, delayed, moves >>

Occupants(b) == { t \in Trains : pos[t] = b }
Idle(t) == attempt[t].target = 0

TypeOK ==
  /\ pos \in [Trains -> 0 .. NumBlocks]
  /\ version \in [Blocks -> 0 .. MaxMoves]
  /\ attempt \in [Trains -> [target : 0 .. NumBlocks, rv : 0 .. MaxMoves]]
  /\ delayed \in [Trains -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ moves \in 0 .. MaxMoves

Init ==
  /\ pos = [t \in Trains |-> 0]
  /\ version = [b \in Blocks |-> 0]
  /\ attempt = [t \in Trains |-> [target |-> 0, rv |-> 0]]
  /\ delayed = [t \in Trains |-> FALSE]
  /\ moves = 0

BeginMove(t, b) ==
  /\ Idle(t)
  /\ pos[t] # b
  /\ attempt' = [attempt EXCEPT ![t] = [target |-> b, rv |-> version[b]]]
  /\ UNCHANGED << pos, version, delayed, moves >>

CommitMove(t) ==
  /\ ~Idle(t)
  /\ delayed[t] = FALSE
  /\ moves < MaxMoves
  /\ LET b == attempt[t].target IN
       /\ version[b] = attempt[t].rv
       /\ Cardinality(Occupants(b)) < Cap(b)
       /\ pos' = [pos EXCEPT ![t] = b]
       /\ version' = [version EXCEPT ![b] = version[b] + 1]
  /\ attempt' = [attempt EXCEPT ![t] = [target |-> 0, rv |-> 0]]
  /\ moves' = moves + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED delayed

RetryMove(t) ==
  /\ ~Idle(t)
  /\ version[attempt[t].target] # attempt[t].rv
  /\ attempt' = [attempt EXCEPT ![t] = [target |-> 0, rv |-> 0]]
  /\ UNCHANGED << pos, version, delayed, moves >>

Stall(t) ==
  /\ delayed[t] = FALSE
  /\ delayed' = [delayed EXCEPT ![t] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED << pos, version, attempt, moves >>

Resume(t) ==
  /\ delayed[t] = TRUE
  /\ delayed' = [delayed EXCEPT ![t] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED << pos, version, attempt, moves >>

Next ==
  \/ \E t \in Trains, b \in Blocks : BeginMove(t, b)
  \/ \E t \in Trains : CommitMove(t)
  \/ \E t \in Trains : RetryMove(t)
  \/ \E t \in Trains : Stall(t)
  \/ \E t \in Trains : Resume(t)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Bounded capacity: no block ever holds more trains than it is rated for.
WithinCapacity ==
  \A b \in Blocks : Cardinality(Occupants(b)) <= Cap(b)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Trains = {t1, t2, t3}
  NumBlocks = 2
  MaxMoves = 4
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT WithinCapacity
nl:
A subway signalling system controls movement of trains between track blocks. Each block has a fixed holding capacity: short interlocking blocks admit a single train, while a longer platform block admits two. Trains move under optimistic concurrency: to enter a target block a train first snapshots that block's version counter, then attempts to commit the move. The commit succeeds only if the block's version is unchanged since the snapshot (nobody else moved into it meanwhile) and the block still has spare capacity; a successful commit places the train and bumps the block's version. If the version has changed, the snapshot is stale, so the train abandons the attempt and will retry later. A train may become slow and stall its in-flight attempt without failing outright; while stalled it cannot commit, and it can resume afterward. The signalling logic must never let a block hold more trains than its rated capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state, the number of trains occupying any block is at most that block's rated capacity.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od13m4p1t1 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS NumJobs, QCap

Ids == 1 .. NumJobs
\* Distinct adjustment amounts so the ledger cannot be faked by a bare count.
Delta(id) == IF id = 1 THEN 3 ELSE IF id = 2 THEN 2 ELSE 1

RECURSIVE SumOver(_)
SumOver(S) ==
  IF S = {} THEN 0
  ELSE LET x == CHOOSE e \in S : TRUE IN Delta(x) + SumOver(S \ {x})

VARIABLES value, queue, applied, refused
vars == << value, queue, applied, refused >>

New(id) == id \notin queue /\ id \notin applied /\ id \notin refused

TypeOK ==
  /\ value \in 0 .. SumOver(Ids)
  /\ queue \subseteq Ids
  /\ applied \subseteq Ids
  /\ refused \subseteq Ids

Init ==
  /\ value = 0
  /\ queue = {}
  /\ applied = {}
  /\ refused = {}

Submit(id) ==
  /\ New(id)
  /\ Cardinality(queue) < QCap
  /\ queue' = queue \cup {id}
  /\ UNCHANGED << value, applied, refused >>

Refuse(id) ==
  /\ New(id)
  /\ Cardinality(queue) = QCap
  /\ refused' = refused \cup {id}
  /\ UNCHANGED << value, queue, applied >>

Retry(id) ==
  /\ id \in refused
  /\ Cardinality(queue) < QCap
  /\ queue' = queue \cup {id}
  /\ refused' = refused \ {id}
  /\ UNCHANGED << value, applied >>

Apply(id) ==
  /\ id \in queue
  /\ queue' = queue \ {id}
  /\ applied' = applied \cup {id}
  /\ value' = value + Delta(id)
  /\ UNCHANGED refused

AllApplied == \A id \in Ids : id \in applied

Next ==
  \/ \E id \in Ids : Submit(id)
  \/ \E id \in Ids : Refuse(id)
  \/ \E id \in Ids : Retry(id)
  \/ \E id \in Ids : Apply(id)
  \/ (AllApplied /\ UNCHANGED vars)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lost / phantom updates: the shared ledger faithfully reflects exactly the
\* set of applied jobs, folded by their individual adjustment amounts.
FaithfulLedger == value = SumOver(applied)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  NumJobs = 4
  QCap = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT FaithfulLedger
nl:
A network of vending machines feeds inventory-adjustment jobs into a central worker that maintains one shared stock-ledger value. Submitted jobs wait in a bounded work queue. When the queue is already full, a further submission is refused rather than buffered, which is the backpressure that keeps the worker from being swamped; refused jobs are remembered so they can be retried once the queue drains. The worker does not process jobs in submission order: it may pick any queued job next, so effectively the jobs are reordered. Applying a job removes it from the queue, marks it done, and folds its adjustment amount into the shared ledger value; different jobs carry different adjustment amounts. Every job is submitted at most once, and a refused job can later be resubmitted when there is room. The correctness concern is that no accepted adjustment is ever silently dropped or double-counted, so the shared ledger value must always equal exactly the sum of the adjustment amounts of the jobs that have been applied.
SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state, the shared ledger value equals the sum of the adjustment amounts of exactly the set of jobs that have been applied, so no update is lost or double-counted.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od2m5p1t2 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS NumProps, Voters, Quorum

Props == 1 .. NumProps
Zones == {"zA", "zB"}

Owner(p) == IF p <= 2 THEN "instA" ELSE "instB"
Zone(p)  == IF p % 2 = 0 THEN "zA" ELSE "zB"
Delta(p) == IF p = 1 THEN 3 ELSE IF p = 3 THEN 2 ELSE 1

RECURSIVE SumForZone(_, _)
SumForZone(S, z) ==
  IF S = {} THEN 0
  ELSE LET x == CHOOSE e \in S : TRUE
           rest == SumForZone(S \ {x}, z)
       IN IF Zone(x) = z THEN Delta(x) + rest ELSE rest

VARIABLES record, votes, committed, abandoned
vars == << record, votes, committed, abandoned >>

Pending(p) == p \notin committed /\ p \notin abandoned

TypeOK ==
  /\ record \in [Zones -> 0 .. 100]
  /\ votes \in [Props -> SUBSET Voters]
  /\ committed \subseteq Props
  /\ abandoned \subseteq Props

Init ==
  /\ record = [z \in Zones |-> 0]
  /\ votes = [p \in Props |-> {}]
  /\ committed = {}
  /\ abandoned = {}

Approve(v, p) ==
  /\ Pending(p)
  /\ v \notin votes[p]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![p] = votes[p] \cup {v}]
  /\ UNCHANGED << record, committed, abandoned >>

Revoke(v, p) ==
  /\ Pending(p)
  /\ v \in votes[p]
  /\ Cardinality(votes[p]) < Quorum
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![p] = votes[p] \ {v}]
  /\ UNCHANGED << record, committed, abandoned >>

Commit(p) ==
  /\ Pending(p)
  /\ Cardinality(votes[p]) >= Quorum
  /\ committed' = committed \cup {p}
  /\ record' = [record EXCEPT ![Zone(p)] = record[Zone(p)] + Delta(p)]
  /\ UNCHANGED << votes, abandoned >>

Abandon(p) ==
  /\ Pending(p)
  /\ Cardinality(votes[p]) < Quorum
  /\ abandoned' = abandoned \cup {p}
  /\ UNCHANGED << record, votes, committed >>

Settled == \A p \in Props : ~Pending(p)

Next ==
  \/ \E v \in Voters, p \in Props : Approve(v, p)
  \/ \E v \in Voters, p \in Props : Revoke(v, p)
  \/ \E p \in Props : Commit(p)
  \/ \E p \in Props : Abandon(p)
  \/ (Settled /\ UNCHANGED vars)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lost, forged, or double-counted updates: each zone reflects exactly its
\* committed proposals' folded adjustments, and every commit held a quorum.
NoLostUpdate ==
  /\ \A z \in Zones : record[z] = SumForZone(committed, z)
  /\ \A p \in committed : Cardinality(votes[p]) >= Quorum
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  NumProps = 4
  Voters = {r1, r2, r3}
  Quorum = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet is driven by two independent control instances that both draw from one shared pool of voting robots. Each control instance issues proposals that adjust a shared bin-count record keyed by storage zone. A proposal takes effect only after it collects a quorum (a strict majority) of approvals from the shared robot pool; robots may approve a proposal and may also revoke their approval before it commits. When a proposal has gathered a quorum it commits, folding its adjustment amount into the record for its target zone; each proposal names one zone and carries its own adjustment amount. A proposal that fails to attract enough interest can be abandoned before committing. Because both instances share the same voters, care is needed that committed proposals are neither dropped nor double-applied. Each zone's stored count must always equal the sum of the adjustment amounts of exactly those committed proposals that targeted that zone, and every committed proposal must genuinely have held a quorum.
SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state, each zone's record equals the summed adjustments of exactly the committed proposals targeting it, and every committed proposal was approved by a quorum, so no update is lost, forged, or double-counted.

spec_text:
-------------------------- MODULE W4Od15m0p4t4 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS Traders, MaxCap, MaxVer

VARIABLES book, version, capacity, pending, snap
vars == << book, version, capacity, pending, snap >>

TypeOK ==
  /\ book \subseteq Traders
  /\ version \in 0 .. MaxVer
  /\ capacity \in 0 .. MaxCap
  /\ pending \in [Traders -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ snap \in [Traders -> 0 .. MaxVer]

Init ==
  /\ book = {}
  /\ version = 0
  /\ capacity = 1
  /\ pending = [t \in Traders |-> FALSE]
  /\ snap = [t \in Traders |-> 0]

BeginInsert(t) ==
  /\ pending[t] = FALSE
  /\ t \notin book
  /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![t] = TRUE]
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![t] = version]
  /\ UNCHANGED << book, version, capacity >>

CommitInsert(t) ==
  /\ pending[t] = TRUE
  /\ snap[t] = version
  /\ t \notin book
  /\ Cardinality(book) < capacity
  /\ version < MaxVer
  /\ book' = book \cup {t}
  /\ version' = version + 1
  /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![t] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED << capacity, snap >>

RetryInsert(t) ==
  /\ pending[t] = TRUE
  /\ snap[t] # version
  /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![t] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED << book, version, capacity, snap >>

CancelOrder(t) ==
  /\ t \in book
  /\ version < MaxVer
  /\ book' = book \ {t}
  /\ version' = version + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED << capacity, pending, snap >>

RaiseCapacity ==
  /\ capacity < MaxCap
  /\ capacity' = capacity + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED << book, version, pending, snap >>

LowerCapacity ==
  /\ capacity > Cardinality(book)
  /\ capacity' = capacity - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED << book, version, pending, snap >>

Next ==
  \/ \E t \in Traders : BeginInsert(t)
  \/ \E t \in Traders : CommitInsert(t)
  \/ \E t \in Traders : RetryInsert(t)
  \/ \E t \in Traders : CancelOrder(t)
  \/ RaiseCapacity
  \/ LowerCapacity
  \/ (version = MaxVer /\ UNCHANGED vars)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Bounded capacity, even as capacity is raised and lowered at runtime.
BookWithinCapacity == Cardinality(book) <= capacity
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Traders = {a, b, c}
  MaxCap = 3
  MaxVer = 5
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT BookWithinCapacity
nl:
A stock exchange runs an opening auction whose order book has a bounded capacity that the exchange can adjust while the auction is live. Traders insert orders using optimistic concurrency: a trader first snapshots the book's version counter, then attempts to commit the insert. The commit succeeds only if the version is unchanged since the snapshot and the book still has room below its current capacity; a successful insert adds the order and bumps the version. If the version moved, the snapshot is stale and the trader abandons the attempt to retry later. A trader may cancel a resting order, which also bumps the version. The exchange may raise the capacity at any time, and may lower it, but never below the number of orders currently resting in the book. Each trader holds at most one resting order. The auction must never let the order book hold more orders than its current capacity allows.
SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state, the number of resting orders in the book does not exceed the book's current capacity.

spec_text:
-------------------------- MODULE W4Od2m8p1t2 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS NumRobots, NumCells

Robots == 1 .. NumRobots
Cells  == 1 .. NumCells
Zones  == {1, 2}
NoOwner == 0

Zone(c)  == IF c <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 2
Delta(r) == IF r = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1
Writes   == [robot : Robots, cell : Cells]

RECURSIVE SumForCell(_, _)
SumForCell(S, c) ==

  /\ fine \in [Cells -> 0 .. NumRobots]
  /\ phase \in [Robots -> {"idle", "coarse", "fine"}]
  /\ record \in [Cells -> 0 .. 100]
  /\ applied \subseteq Writes

  /\ fine = [c \in Cells |-> NoOwner]
  /\ phase = [r \in Robots |-> "idle"]
  /\ record = [c \in Cells |-> 0]
  /\ applied = {}

AcquireCoarse(r, z) ==
  /\ phase[r] = "idle"
  /\ coarse[z] = NoOwner
  /\ coarse' = [coarse EXCEPT ![z] = r]
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![r] = "coarse"]

  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![r] = "fine"]

  /\ fine[c] = r

  /\ [robot |-> r, cell |-> c] \notin applied

\* and every cell's record faithfully reflects the robots that wrote it.

  NumRobots = 2
  NumCells = 3

A warehouse robot fleet, driven by two independent control instances that share one pool of robots, maintains a shared per-cell stock record. To write a storage cell a robot must acquire locks hierarchically: first the coarse lock on the cell's zone, then the fine lock on the individual cell. Only a robot that already holds the enclosing zone's coarse lock may take a cell's fine lock. While holding both, the robot applies its adjustment to that cell's record and immediately releases the fine lock; each robot contributes a fixed adjustment amount, and a given robot writes any given cell at most once. A robot releases the coarse lock only after it holds no fine lock in that zone. Because writes are serialized through this nested locking, concurrent robots can never clobber each other, so no update is lost. A subway signalling system allocates track slots to trains under the direction of an elected controller. Controllers elect a leader by advancing an epoch counter; on failover any controller may win a fresh election, bumping the epoch and becoming the new leader.   /\ UNCHANGED << reg, enrolled, seatOf, snap >>

Next ==
  \/ \E s \in Students : ReadReg(s)
  \/ \E s \in Students : CASEnroll(s)
  \/ \E s \in Students : CASFail(s)
  \/ \E s \in Students : Waitlist(s)

\* Compare-and-swap integrity: assigned seats are exactly {1..reg}, so no seat

CONSTANTS
  Students = {s1, s2, s3}
  Cap = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT CASIntegrity
nl:
A university course-registration system seats students into a single capped course using a compare-and-swap seat register that counts seats taken. To enroll, a student first reads the current register value as a snapshot, then attempts a compare-and-swap: the swap succeeds only if the register still equals the snapshot and the course is not yet full, in which case it increments the register and assigns the student the next seat number. Because requests arrive over an unreliable channel they are effectively reordered: any pending student may act next. If the snapshot is stale (the register moved), the attempt fails and the student may retry. If the course is full when a snapshot-consistent attempt is made, the student is waitlisted instead. Enrollment is irreversible and each student enrolls at most once. The seat register and the assigned seat numbers must stay perfectly consistent: the set of seat numbers held by enrolled students must be exactly the block one through the register value, with no gaps and no duplicates.

A hospital operating-room scheduler manages a set of individual operating rooms, each of which is either open or closed and holds at most one surgery at a time. When a surgery finishes it discharges from its room, which becomes empty again, and the case is recorded as completed.   /\ cached \in [Robots -> 0 .. MaxEpoch]
  /\ mode \in [Robots -> {"idle", "executing"}]
  /\ budget \in 0 .. AdminBudget

Init ==
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ roster = Robots
  /\ cached = [r \in Robots |-> 0]
  /\ mode = [r \in Robots |-> "idle"]
  /\ budget = AdminBudget

Reconfigure(newRoster) ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ roster' = newRoster
  /\ mode' = [r \in Robots |-> "idle"]
  /\ UNCHANGED << cached, budget >>

AdminOverride(newRoster) ==
  /\ budget > 0
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ roster' = newRoster
  /\ mode' = [r \in Robots |-> "idle"]
  /\ budget' = budget - 1
  /\ UNCHANGED cached

Sync(r) ==
  /\ r \in roster
  /\ cached[r] # epoch
  /\ cached' = [cached EXCEPT ![r] = epoch]
  /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, roster, mode, budget >>

Execute(r) ==
  /\ r \in roster
  /\ cached[r] = epoch
  /\ mode[r] = "idle"
  /\ mode' = [mode EXCEPT ![r] = "executing"]
  /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, roster, cached, budget >>

Stop(r) ==
  /\ mode[r] = "executing"
  /\ mode' = [mode EXCEPT ![r] = "idle"]
  /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, roster, cached, budget >>

Next ==
  \/ \E nr \in SUBSET Robots : Reconfigure(nr)
  \/ \E nr \in SUBSET Robots : AdminOverride(nr)
  \/ \E r \in Robots : Sync(r)
  \/ \E r \in Robots : Execute(r)
  \/ \E r \in Robots : Stop(r)
  \/ (epoch = MaxEpoch /\ UNCHANGED vars)

\* No stale or unauthorized action: an executing robot is current-rostered and
\* has synced its cached epoch to the live global epoch.
AuthorizedActorsOnly ==
  \A r \in Robots :
    mode[r] = "executing" => (r \in roster /\ cached[r] = epoch)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Robots = {w1, w2, w3}
  MaxEpoch = 2
  AdminBudget = 1
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT AuthorizedActorsOnly
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet operates under a configuration that is revised in numbered epochs. Each epoch has an authorized roster of robots and a global epoch number; every robot also caches the epoch it last synced to. A reconfiguration advances the global epoch and installs a fresh roster, and in doing so it stands down every robot that was executing, because after an epoch change all robots are momentarily out of date. A robot brings itself up to date by syncing its cached epoch to the global one, but only if it is on the current roster. A robot may begin executing a task only when it is on the current roster and its cached epoch equals the global epoch; it may stop at any time. A privileged fleet administrator can override the configuration, advancing the epoch and installing any roster within a bounded override budget, again standing down all executing robots. The safety requirement is that no stale or unauthorized robot ever executes.
SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state, any robot that is executing is on the current roster and has a cached epoch equal to the global epoch, so no stale or unauthorized robot acts.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od8m2p0t3 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS NumTxns, Participants

Txns == 1 .. NumTxns

VARIABLES phase, votes, locked, holder, slow
vars == << phase, votes, locked, holder, slow >>

TypeOK ==
  /\ phase \in [Txns -> {"idle", "preparing", "committed"}]
  /\ votes \in [Txns -> SUBSET Participants]
  /\ locked \in BOOLEAN
  /\ holder \in 0 .. NumTxns
  /\ slow \in [Participants -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
  /\ phase = [t \in Txns |-> "idle"]
  /\ votes = [t \in Txns |-> {}]
  /\ locked = FALSE
  /\ holder = 0
  /\ slow = [p \in Participants |-> FALSE]

BeginPrepare(t) ==
  /\ phase[t] = "idle"
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![t] = "preparing"]
  /\ UNCHANGED << votes, locked, holder, slow >>

Vote(p, t) ==
  /\ phase[t] = "preparing"
  /\ slow[p] = FALSE
  /\ p \notin votes[t]
  /\ \A u \in Txns : u # t => p \notin votes[u]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![t] = votes[t] \cup {p}]
  /\ UNCHANGED << phase, locked, holder, slow >>

Commit(t) ==
  /\ phase[t] = "preparing"
  /\ votes[t] = Participants
  /\ locked = FALSE
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![t] = "committed"]
  /\ locked' = TRUE
  /\ holder' = t
  /\ UNCHANGED << votes, slow >>

Release(t) ==
  /\ phase[t] = "committed"
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![t] = "idle"]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![t] = {}]
  /\ locked' = FALSE
  /\ holder' = 0
  /\ UNCHANGED slow

Abort(t) ==
  /\ phase[t] = "preparing"
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![t] = "idle"]
  /\ votes' = [votes EXCEPT ![t] = {}]
  /\ UNCHANGED << locked, holder, slow >>

Stall(p) ==
  /\ slow[p] = FALSE
  /\ slow' = [slow EXCEPT ![p] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED << phase, votes, locked, holder >>

Resume(p) ==
  /\ slow[p] = TRUE
  /\ slow' = [slow EXCEPT ![p] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED << phase, votes, locked, holder >>

Next ==
  \/ \E t \in Txns : BeginPrepare(t)
  \/ \E p \in Participants, t \in Txns : Vote(p, t)
  \/ \E t \in Txns : Commit(t)
  \/ \E t \in Txns : Release(t)
  \/ \E t \in Txns : Abort(t)
  \/ \E p \in Participants : Stall(p)
  \/ \E p \in Participants : Resume(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Mutual exclusion: a transaction in the critical section holds the lock and is
\* the recorded holder; with a single holder, at most one is ever in the section.
MutualExclusion ==
  \A t \in Txns : phase[t] = "committed" => (locked = TRUE /\ holder = t)
=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
  NumTxns = 2
  Participants = {p1, p2}
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT MutualExclusion
nl:
A university course-registration system grants exclusive use of one shared lab resource to at most one enrollment transaction at a time, coordinating each grant with two-phase commit across a set of resource-manager participants. A transaction begins by preparing, then collects yes-votes from participants; each participant will back only one transaction at a time, refusing to vote for a second while its vote stands with another. A participant can be slow and temporarily stop voting, but it has not failed and may resume. A transaction commits only when every participant has voted for it and the lab resource is currently free; committing seizes the resource lock and records the transaction as its holder, placing that transaction in the critical section. The holder later releases, freeing the lock and clearing votes. A preparing transaction may instead abort, releasing the votes it had gathered. Because participants back a single transaction and commit requires unanimity plus a free lock, the lab resource is never held by two transactions at once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state, any transaction in the critical section holds the resource lock and is recorded as its holder, so the lab resource is never used by two transactions simultaneously.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od18m1p4t0 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS NumCtl, Doors, MaxOpen

Controllers == 1 .. NumCtl
Alive(cr) == { c \in Controllers : cr[c] = FALSE }

\* Next live controller cyclically after t (skips the one crashed controller).
NextAlive(t, cr) ==
  CHOOSE c \in Alive(cr) :
    \E k \in 1 .. NumCtl :
      /\ c = ((t + k - 1) % NumCtl) + 1
      /\ \A j \in 1 .. (k - 1) : (((t + j - 1) % NumCtl) + 1) \notin Alive(cr)

VARIABLES unlocked, token, transit, crashed
vars == << unlocked, token, transit, crashed >>

TypeOK ==
  /\ unlocked \subseteq Doors
  /\ token \in Controllers
  /\ transit \in BOOLEAN
  /\ crashed \in [Controllers -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
  /\ unlocked = {}
  /\ token = 1
  /\ transit = FALSE
  /\ crashed = [c \in Controllers |-> FALSE]

Unlock(c, d) ==
  /\ c = token
  /\ transit = FALSE
  /\ crashed[c] = FALSE
  /\ d \notin unlocked
  /\ Cardinality(unlocked) < MaxOpen
  /\ unlocked' = unlocked \cup {d}
  /\ UNCHANGED << token, transit, crashed >>

Lock(c, d) ==
  /\ c = token
  /\ transit = FALSE
  /\ crashed[c] = FALSE
  /\ d \in unlocked
  /\ unlocked' = unlocked \ {d}
  /\ UNCHANGED << token, transit, crashed >>

BeginPass ==
  /\ transit = FALSE
  /\ transit' = TRUE
  /\ UNCHANGED << unlocked, token, crashed >>

Deliver ==
  /\ transit = TRUE
  /\ token' = NextAlive(token, crashed)
  /\ transit' = FALSE
  /\ UNCHANGED << unlocked, crashed >>

Crash(c) ==
  /\ \A o \in Controllers : crashed[o] = FALSE
  /\ crashed' = [crashed EXCEPT ![c] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED << unlocked, token, transit >>

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Controllers, d \in Doors : Unlock(c, d)
  \/ \E c \in Controllers, d \in Doors : Lock(c, d)
  \/ BeginPass
  \/ Deliver
  \/ \E c \in Controllers : Crash(c)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Bounded capacity: never more than the allowed number of doors unlocked.
WithinOpenLimit == Cardinality(unlocked) <= MaxOpen
=============================================================================

CONSTANTS
  NumCtl = 3
  Doors = {d1, d2, d3}
  MaxOpen = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT WithinOpenLimit
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network lets a ring of controllers actuate a set of door locks, but for security at most a bounded number of doors may be unlocked at once. The controllers pass a single token around a ring; only the controller holding the resting token may unlock or lock a door, and it may unlock a door only while the number of currently unlocked doors is below the allowed maximum. Passing the token puts it into transit and then delivers it to the next live controller, wrapping around the ring. One controller may crash silently: it simply stops participating, and the ring routes the token past it on delivery by skipping crashed controllers. A crashed controller performs no unlock or lock actions. At most one controller ever crashes. Whatever the controllers do and whichever one crashes, the network must never leave more than the allowed maximum number of doors unlocked simultaneously.
SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state, the number of simultaneously unlocked doors is at most the allowed maximum.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od2m3p6t2 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS NumRobots, NumInst, MaxGen

Robots == 1 .. NumRobots
Instances == 1 .. NumInst

VARIABLES gen, leaderOf, knownGen, actingFor
vars == << gen, leaderOf, knownGen, actingFor >>

TypeOK ==
  /\ gen \in [Instances -> 0 .. MaxGen]
  /\ leaderOf \in [Instances -> 0 .. NumRobots]
  /\ knownGen \in [Robots -> 0 .. MaxGen]
  /\ actingFor \in [Robots -> 0 .. NumInst]

Init ==
  /\ gen = [i \in Instances |-> 0]
  /\ leaderOf = [i \in Instances |-> 0]
  /\ knownGen = [r \in Robots |-> 0]
  /\ actingFor = [r \in Robots |-> 0]

Elect(i, r) ==
  /\ gen[i] < MaxGen
  /\ \A j \in Instances : j # i => leaderOf[j] # r
  /\ gen' = [gen EXCEPT ![i] = gen[i] + 1]
  /\ leaderOf' = [leaderOf EXCEPT ![i] = r]
  /\ actingFor' = [x \in Robots |-> IF actingFor[x] = i THEN 0 ELSE actingFor[x]]
  /\ UNCHANGED knownGen

Sync(i, r) ==
  /\ leaderOf[i] = r
  /\ knownGen[r] # gen[i]
  /\ knownGen' = [knownGen EXCEPT ![r] = gen[i]]
  /\ UNCHANGED << gen, leaderOf, actingFor >>

Act(i, r) ==
  /\ leaderOf[i] = r
  /\ knownGen[r] = gen[i]
  /\ actingFor[r] = 0
  /\ actingFor' = [actingFor EXCEPT ![r] = i]
  /\ UNCHANGED << gen, leaderOf, knownGen >>

Stop(r) ==
  /\ actingFor[r] # 0
  /\ actingFor' = [actingFor EXCEPT ![r] = 0]
  /\ UNCHANGED << gen, leaderOf, knownGen >>

Next ==
  \/ \E i \in Instances, r \in Robots : Elect(i, r)
  \/ \E i \in Instances, r \in Robots : Sync(i, r)
  \/ \E i \in Instances, r \in Robots : Act(i, r)
  \/ \E r \in Robots : Stop(r)
  \/ ((\A i \in Instances : gen[i] = MaxGen) /\ UNCHANGED vars)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No stale or unauthorized action: an acting robot is the current leader of the
\* instance it acts for and its known generation is that instance's generation.
NoStaleActor ==
  \A r \in Robots :
    actingFor[r] # 0 =>
      (leaderOf[actingFor[r]] = r /\ knownGen[r] = gen[actingFor[r]])

CONSTANTS
  NumRobots = 2
  NumInst = 2
  MaxGen = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT NoStaleActor
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet is driven by two independent control instances that draw leaders from one shared pool of robots. Each instance maintains its own generation counter and its own elected leader robot. On failover an instance runs a fresh election: it advances its generation and installs a new leader, and it stands down any robot that was currently acting on that instance's behalf, because the generation has moved. A freshly elected leader is initially out of date and must sync its known generation to its instance's current generation before it may act. A robot may begin acting for an instance only when it is that instance's current leader and its known generation equals that instance's generation; it may stop at any time. A robot leads at most one instance at a time, so an instance may not elect a robot that already leads the other instance. The safety requirement is that no stale robot, or robot that is not the current leader of the instance it acts for, ever performs an action.
SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state, any robot acting for an instance is that instance's current leader and has a known generation equal to that instance's generation, so no stale or unauthorized robot acts.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od11m6p0t4 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS NumJobs, NumPrinters, MaxTime, LeaseLen

Jobs == 1 .. NumJobs
Printers == 1 .. NumPrinters

VARIABLES now, holder, expiry, printing, active
vars == << now, holder, expiry, printing, active >>

TypeOK ==
  /\ now \in 0 .. MaxTime
  /\ holder \in [Printers -> 0 .. NumJobs]
  /\ expiry \in [Printers -> 0 .. MaxTime]
  /\ printing \in [Jobs -> 0 .. NumPrinters]
  /\ active \in [Printers -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
  /\ now = 0
  /\ holder = [p \in Printers |-> 0]
  /\ expiry = [p \in Printers |-> 0]
  /\ printing = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]
  /\ active = [p \in Printers |-> TRUE]

AcquireLease(j, p) ==
  /\ active[p] = TRUE
  /\ (holder[p] = 0 \/ expiry[p] < now)
  /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![p] = j]
  /\ expiry' = [expiry EXCEPT ![p] = IF now + LeaseLen > MaxTime THEN MaxTime ELSE now + LeaseLen]
  /\ UNCHANGED << now, printing, active >>

StartPrint(j, p) ==
  /\ holder[p] = j
  /\ expiry[p] >= now
  /\ printing[j] = 0
  /\ printing' = [printing EXCEPT ![j] = p]
  /\ UNCHANGED << now, holder, expiry, active >>

StopPrint(j) ==
  /\ printing[j] # 0
  /\ printing' = [printing EXCEPT ![j] = 0]
  /\ UNCHANGED << now, holder, expiry, active >>

ReleaseLease(j, p) ==
  /\ holder[p] = j
  /\ holder' = [holder EXCEPT ![p] = 0]
  /\ printing' = [printing EXCEPT ![j] = IF printing[j] = p THEN 0 ELSE printing[j]]
  /\ UNCHANGED << now, expiry, active >>

Tick ==
  /\ now < MaxTime
  /\ now' = now + 1
  /\ printing' = [j \in Jobs |->
                    IF printing[j] # 0 /\ expiry[printing[j]] < now + 1
                    THEN 0 ELSE printing[j]]
  /\ UNCHANGED << holder, expiry, active >>

Deactivate(p) ==
  /\ active[p] = TRUE
  /\ holder[p] = 0
  /\ active' = [active EXCEPT ![p] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED << now, holder, expiry, printing >>

Reactivate(p) ==
  /\ active[p] = FALSE
  /\ active' = [active EXCEPT ![p] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED << now, holder, expiry, printing >>

Next ==
  \/ \E j \in Jobs, p \in Printers : AcquireLease(j, p)
  \/ \E j \in Jobs, p \in Printers : StartPrint(j, p)
  \/ \E j \in Jobs : StopPrint(j)
  \/ \E j \in Jobs, p \in Printers : ReleaseLease(j, p)
  \/ Tick
  \/ \E p \in Printers : Deactivate(p)
  \/ \E p \in Printers : Reactivate(p)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Mutual exclusion via unexpired leases: an actively printing job is the
\* current unexpired lease holder of its printer; a printer has one holder.
MutualExclusion ==
  \A j \in Jobs :
    printing[j] # 0 => (holder[printing[j]] = j /\ expiry[printing[j]] >= now)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  NumJobs = 2
  NumPrinters = 2
  MaxTime = 3
  LeaseLen = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT MutualExclusion
nl:
A print-shop job spooler grants exclusive use of physical printers to print jobs using time-bounded leases. A global clock advances in ticks. To use a printer a job acquires a lease on it, which is allowed only if the printer is active and currently unleased or holding an expired lease; the lease records the job as holder and an expiry a fixed span in the future. Only a job holding an unexpired lease on a printer may be actively printing on it. When the clock ticks forward, any job whose printer's lease has expired is immediately evicted and stops printing. A job may release its lease, and may stop printing at any time. The set of active printers changes at runtime: an idle unleased printer may be deactivated, and an inactive printer may be reactivated, so capacity rises and falls. Because a printer records a single lease holder and printing requires an unexpired lease, no printer is ever printed on by two jobs at once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state, any job actively printing is the unexpired lease holder of the printer it prints on, so no printer is ever used by two jobs simultaneously.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m7p3t0 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS NumBanks, MaxSlot

Banks == 1 .. NumBanks

Slots == 1 .. MaxSlot

VARIABLES reg, slotOf, owner, snap, pending, crashed
vars == << reg, slotOf, owner, snap, pending, crashed >>

TypeOK ==
  /\ reg \in 0 .. MaxSlot
  /\ slotOf \in [Banks -> 0 .. MaxSlot]
  /\ owner \in [Slots -> 0 .. NumBanks]
  /\ snap \in [Banks -> 0 .. MaxSlot]
  /\ pending \in [Banks -> BOOLEAN]
  /\ crashed \in [Banks -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
  /\ reg = 0
  /\ slotOf = [b \in Banks |-> 0]
  /\ owner = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
  /\ snap = [b \in Banks |-> 0]
  /\ pending = [b \in Banks |-> FALSE]
  /\ crashed = [b \in Banks |-> FALSE]

ReadReg(b) ==
  /\ crashed[b] = FALSE
  /\ pending[b] = FALSE
  /\ slotOf[b] = 0
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![b] = reg]
  /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![b] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED << reg, slotOf, owner, crashed >>

CASClaim(b) ==
  /\ crashed[b] = FALSE
  /\ pending[b] = TRUE
  /\ snap[b] = reg
  /\ snap[b] < MaxSlot
  /\ LET s == snap[b] + 1 IN
       /\ slotOf' = [slotOf EXCEPT ![b] = s]
       /\ owner' = [owner EXCEPT ![s] = b]
       /\ reg' = s
  /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![b] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED << snap, crashed >>

CASAbort(b) ==
  /\ crashed[b] = FALSE
  /\ pending[b] = TRUE
  /\ (snap[b] # reg \/ reg = MaxSlot)
  /\ pending' = [pending EXCEPT ![b] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED << reg, slotOf, owner, snap, crashed >>

Crash(b) ==
  /\ \A o \in Banks : crashed[o] = FALSE
  /\ crashed' = [crashed EXCEPT ![b] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED << reg, slotOf, owner, snap, pending >>

AllSettled == \A b \in Banks : crashed[b] \/ slotOf[b] # 0

Next ==
  \/ \E b \in Banks : ReadReg(b)
  \/ \E b \in Banks : CASClaim(b)
  \/ \E b \in Banks : CASAbort(b)
  \/ \E b \in Banks : Crash(b)
  \/ (AllSettled /\ UNCHANGED vars)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No double allocation: the bank-to-slot and slot-to-owner records agree, so a
\* slot awarded to a bank names that same bank as its owner.
NoDoubleAllocation ==
  \A b \in Banks : slotOf[b] # 0 => owner[slotOf[b]] = b

CONSTANTS
  NumBanks = 3
  MaxSlot = 3
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT NoDoubleAllocation
nl:
A bank interbank settlement batch assigns each participating bank a unique settlement slot using a compare-and-swap sequence register. To claim a slot a bank first snapshots the register, then performs a compare-and-swap: if the register still equals the snapshot, the swap advances the register to the snapshot plus one and awards the bank the slot numbered snapshot plus one, recording both the bank's assigned slot and the slot's owning bank. If the register has moved, the snapshot is stale and the attempt is abandoned; a bank may also abandon if the register is already at the maximum. One bank may crash silently: it simply stops taking part, performing no reads, claims, or abandonments, and any half-finished attempt of a crashed bank is lost. At most one bank ever crashes. The settlement is correct only if no slot is ever awarded to two different banks, which is captured by the slot-to-owner and bank-to-slot records always being mutually consistent.
SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state, for every bank holding a slot, that slot's recorded owner is that same bank, so no settlement slot is ever double-allocated.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m4p3t3 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

CONSTANTS NumJobs, NumSlots, QCap, MaxRefused

Jobs == 1 .. NumJobs
Slots == 1 .. NumSlots

VARIABLES queue, assigned, slotOwner, refused, slow
vars == << queue, assigned, slotOwner, refused, slow >>

TypeOK ==
  /\ queue \subseteq Jobs
  /\ assigned \in [Jobs -> 0 .. NumSlots]
  /\ slotOwner \in [Slots -> 0 .. NumJobs]
  /\ refused \in 0 .. MaxRefused
  /\ slow \in [Jobs -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
  /\ queue = {}
  /\ assigned = [j \in Jobs |-> 0]
  /\ slotOwner = [s \in Slots |-> 0]
  /\ refused = 0
  /\ slow = [j \in Jobs |-> FALSE]

Submit(j) ==
  /\ slow[j] = FALSE
  /\ j \notin queue
  /\ assigned[j] = 0
  /\ Cardinality(queue) < QCap
  /\ queue' = queue \cup {j}
  /\ UNCHANGED << assigned, slotOwner, refused, slow >>

Refuse(j) ==
  /\ j \notin queue
  /\ assigned[j] = 0
  /\ Cardinality(queue) = QCap
  /\ refused < MaxRefused
  /\ refused' = refused + 1
  /\ UNCHANGED << queue, assigned, slotOwner, slow >>

Assign(j, s) ==
  /\ j \in queue
  /\ slotOwner[s] = 0
  /\ assigned' = [assigned EXCEPT ![j] = s]
  /\ slotOwner' = [slotOwner EXCEPT ![s] = j]
  /\ queue' = queue \ {j}
  /\ UNCHANGED << refused, slow >>

Stall(j) ==
  /\ slow[j] = FALSE
  /\ slow' = [slow EXCEPT ![j] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED << queue, assigned, slotOwner, refused >>

Resume(j) ==
  /\ slow[j] = TRUE
  /\ slow' = [slow EXCEPT ![j] = FALSE]
  /\ UNCHANGED << queue, assigned, slotOwner, refused >>

Next ==
  \/ \E j \in Jobs : Submit(j)
  \/ \E j \in Jobs : Refuse(j)
  \/ \E j \in Jobs, s \in Slots : Assign(j, s)
  \/ \E j \in Jobs : Stall(j)
  \/ \E j \in Jobs : Resume(j)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No double allocation: the job-to-slot and slot-to-owner records agree, so an
\* assigned slot names its holder as owner and cannot belong to a second job.
NoDoubleAllocation ==
  \A j \in Jobs : assigned[j] # 0 => slotOwner[assigned[j]] = j
=============================================================================

  NumJobs = 3
  NumSlots = 3
  QCap = 2
  MaxRefused = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT NoDoubleAllocation
nl:
A bank interbank settlement batch collects settlement jobs into a bounded work queue and assigns each a unique settlement slot. Jobs waiting for assignment sit in the queue; when the queue is already full, a further job is refused rather than buffered, which is the backpressure that protects the settlement engine, and refusals are counted. The settlement engine takes a queued job and assigns it a slot, but only a slot that is currently unowned, recording both the job's assigned slot and the slot's owning job. A job that is already assigned is never re-queued. A submitting bank can become slow and temporarily stop submitting its job, but it has not failed and may resume later. No settlement slot may ever be handed to two different jobs; correctness is captured by the job-to-slot and slot-to-owner records always agreeing.
SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state, for every job that has been assigned a slot, that slot's recorded owner is that same job, so no slot is ever double-allocated.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od3m0p6t0 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS Banks, MaxVer

VARIABLES version, members, snap, phase, crashed
vars == << version, members, snap, phase, crashed >>

TypeOK ==
  /\ version \in 0 .. MaxVer
  /\ members \subseteq Banks
  /\ snap \in [Banks -> 0 .. MaxVer]
  /\ phase \in [Banks -> {"idle", "reading", "validated"}]
  /\ crashed \in [Banks -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
  /\ version = 0
  /\ members = Banks
  /\ snap = [b \in Banks |-> 0]
  /\ phase = [b \in Banks |-> "idle"]
  /\ crashed = [b \in Banks |-> FALSE]

BeginRead(b) ==
  /\ b \in members
  /\ crashed[b] = FALSE
  /\ phase[b] = "idle"
  /\ snap' = [snap EXCEPT ![b] = version]
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![b] = "reading"]
  /\ UNCHANGED << version, members, crashed >>

Validate(b) ==
  /\ phase[b] = "reading"
  /\ b \in members
  /\ crashed[b] = FALSE
  /\ snap[b] = version
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![b] = "validated"]
  /\ UNCHANGED << version, members, snap, crashed >>

Apply(b) ==
  /\ phase[b] = "validated"
  /\ version < MaxVer
  /\ version' = version + 1
  /\ phase' = [c \in Banks |->
                 IF c = b THEN "idle"
                 ELSE IF phase[c] = "validated" THEN "reading"
                 ELSE phase[c]]
  /\ UNCHANGED << members, snap, crashed >>

RetryRead(b) ==
  /\ phase[b] = "reading"
  /\ snap[b] # version
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![b] = "idle"]
  /\ UNCHANGED << version, members, snap, crashed >>

Deauthorize(b) ==
  /\ b \in members
  /\ members' = members \ {b}
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![b] = IF phase[b] = "validated" THEN "idle" ELSE phase[b]]
  /\ UNCHANGED << version, snap, crashed >>

Authorize(b) ==
  /\ b \notin members
  /\ members' = members \cup {b}
  /\ UNCHANGED << version, snap, phase, crashed >>

Crash(b) ==
  /\ \A o \in Banks : crashed[o] = FALSE
  /\ crashed' = [crashed EXCEPT ![b] = TRUE]
  /\ phase' = [phase EXCEPT ![b] = IF phase[b] = "validated" THEN "idle" ELSE phase[b]]
  /\ UNCHANGED << version, members, snap >>

Next ==
  \/ \E b \in Banks : BeginRead(b)
  \/ \E b \in Banks : Validate(b)
  \/ \E b \in Banks : Apply(b)
  \/ \E b \in Banks : RetryRead(b)
  \/ \E b \in Banks : Deauthorize(b)
  \/ \E b \in Banks : Authorize(b)
  \/ \E b \in Banks : Crash(b)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No unauthorized or stale actor poised to apply: a validated bank is always a
\* current, uncrashed member holding a snapshot equal to the live version.
AuthorizedFreshOnly ==
  \A b \in Banks :
    phase[b] = "validated" =>
      (b \in members /\ crashed[b] = FALSE /\ snap[b] = version)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  Banks = {b1, b2, b3}
  MaxVer = 3
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT AuthorizedFreshOnly
nl:
A bank interbank settlement batch lets authorized member banks post entries to a shared ledger under optimistic concurrency. The ledger carries a version counter. To post, a member bank first reads the version into a snapshot, then validates: it may move to a validated (about-to-apply) state only if it is still a member, not crashed, and its snapshot still equals the current version. A validated bank then applies its post, which increments the ledger version; applying also forces every other validated bank back to re-reading, because their snapshots are now stale. A bank whose snapshot has fallen behind the version must abandon and re-read. Membership can change: a bank may be deauthorized (and if it was validated it is stood down) or later reauthorized. One bank may crash silently at most once; a crashed bank takes no further part, and if it was validated it is stood down. The safety requirement is that no unauthorized, crashed, or stale bank is ever in the validated, about-to-apply state.
SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state, any bank in the validated about-to-apply state is a current member, is not crashed, and holds a snapshot equal to the current ledger version, so no unauthorized or stale participant is ever poised to act.

-------------------------- MODULE W4Od4m9p1t0 --------------------------
EXTENDS Naturals

CONSTANTS NumStations, Cars, MaxEpoch

Stations == 1 .. NumStations
Weight(st) == IF st = 1 THEN 3 ELSE IF st = 2 THEN 2 ELSE 1
Applications == [station : Stations, car : Cars]

RECURSIVE FoldWeight(_, _)
FoldWeight(S, car) ==
  IF S = {} THEN 0
  ELSE LET a == CHOOSE e \in S : TRUE
           rest == FoldWeight(S \ {a}, car)
       IN IF a.car = car THEN Weight(a.station) + rest ELSE rest

VARIABLES record, applied, epoch, active, entered, crashed
vars == << record, applied, epoch, active, entered, crashed >>

TypeOK ==
  /\ record \in [Cars -> 0 .. 30]
  /\ applied \subseteq Applications
  /\ epoch \in 0 .. MaxEpoch
  /\ active \subseteq Stations
  /\ entered \subseteq Cars
  /\ crashed \in [Stations -> BOOLEAN]

Init ==
  /\ record = [c \in Cars |-> 0]
  /\ applied = {}
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ active = Stations
  /\ entered = {}
  /\ crashed = [st \in Stations |-> FALSE]

EnterCar(c) ==
  /\ c \notin entered
  /\ entered' = entered \cup {c}
  /\ UNCHANGED << record, applied, epoch, active, crashed >>

ApplyStep(st, c) ==
  /\ st \in active
  /\ crashed[st] = FALSE
  /\ c \in entered
  /\ [station |-> st, car |-> c] \notin applied
  /\ record' = [record EXCEPT ![c] = record[c] + Weight(st)]
  /\ applied' = applied \cup {[station |-> st, car |-> c]}
  /\ UNCHANGED << epoch, active, entered, crashed >>

Reconfigure(newActive) ==
  /\ epoch < MaxEpoch
  /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
  /\ active' = newActive
  /\ UNCHANGED << record, applied, entered, crashed >>

Crash(st) ==
  /\ \A o \in Stations : crashed[o] = FALSE
  /\ crashed' = [crashed EXCEPT ![st] = TRUE]
  /\ UNCHANGED << record, applied, epoch, active, entered >>

Next ==
  \/ \E c \in Cars : EnterCar(c)
  \/ \E st \in Stations, c \in Cars : ApplyStep(st, c)
  \/ \E na \in SUBSET Stations : Reconfigure(na)
  \/ \E st \in Stations : Crash(st)
  \/ (epoch = MaxEpoch /\ UNCHANGED vars)

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* No lost or double-counted updates: each car's record faithfully reflects the
\* summed weights of exactly the station applications recorded for it.
FaithfulRecord ==
  \A c \in Cars : record[c] = FoldWeight(applied, c)
=============================================================================
cfg_text:
CONSTANTS
  NumStations = 3
  Cars = {car1, car2}
  MaxEpoch = 2
SPECIFICATION Spec
INVARIANT FaithfulRecord
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line runs a lineup of wash stations that each apply a weighted wash step to cars moving along the line, accumulating a per-car wash-score record. The lineup is reconfigured in numbered epochs: a reconfiguration advances the epoch and installs a new set of active stations. A car must first enter the line before any station may work on it. An active, uncrashed station applies its step to an entered car exactly once, adding its own step weight to that car's record; different stations carry different weights. One station may crash silently at most once: it simply stops working and applies no further steps. Because stations are reconfigured across epochs and one may crash mid-run, the concern is that no station's contribution is ever dropped or double-counted. Each car's wash-score record must always equal exactly the sum of the step weights of the station-and-car applications that have actually occurred for that car.
SAFETY PROPERTY: In every reachable state, each car's wash-score record equals the summed step weights of exactly the station applications recorded for that car, so no update is lost or double-counted.
